boundary_rules.rule: LevelData V1 is fixed-schema declarative level data with integer palette-index cells.
scrubbots.level_supply_plan.v1 contains fixed-schema declarative supply-plan data.
scrubbots.level.metadata.v1 contains fixed-schema declarative publisher metadata.

Executable, interpreted, script, plugin, addon, autoload, native, module, remote resource behavior, eval/exec, hidden activation, review evasion, and behavior-changing feature injection remain outside the current boundary.
CP007 dry-run planning is local and records remote_mutation_performed as false.
CP008 defines provider-neutral interfaces but ships no concrete network or storage provider.
CP006 contains no publishing credential values or project-data credential retrieval.
M15/M16 runtime and M18 provider delivery behavior are not implemented or verified by this snapshot.

required_tasks.action: Re-fetch current official Google Play policies before production launch.
Re-fetch current official Apple policies before production launch.

sources.policy_paraphrase: Bars self-update outside Play and executable-code downloads from outside Play, with stated interpreter or virtual-machine nuances; runtime-loaded interpreted code remains subject to policy.
sources.relevance: Supports keeping remote executable content outside the declarative M11 payload boundary.
sources.title: Device and Network Abuse

sources.policy_paraphrase: Requires accurate functionality and content disclosures, necessary additional resources with a user prompt and download-size disclosure, and bars hidden functionality and review evasion.
sources.relevance: Remote level content must remain inside the disclosed game contract; a future resource download flow needs a separate implementation-specific review.
sources.title: Deceptive Behavior

sources.policy_paraphrase: States that Play policies are regularly updated and lists dated prior versions; the latest listed archive entry at this check was August 26, 2026.
sources.relevance: Provides dated change-history context and supports requiring a fresh release-time policy check.
sources.title: Policy Archive

sources.policy_paraphrase: Guideline 2.5.2 expects a self-contained app and bars downloaded, installed, or executed code that introduces or changes app features or functionality, subject to a limited educational-code provision. Guideline 4.7 covers specified non-embedded software categories with additional conditions.
sources.relevance: The M11 contract uses fixed-schema data and does not rely on the mini-app/software provisions to serve SCRUBBOTS levels.
sources.title: App Review Guidelines

sources.policy_paraphrase: Section 3.3.1(B) generally bars executable-code downloads or installation and constrains interpreted code; 3.3.1(C) restricts enabling additional functionality through other distribution mechanisms absent prior written approval or an identified exception.
sources.relevance: Reinforces the M11 boundary against code, plugins, or remote feature switches; no runtime provider is present for delivery assessment.
sources.title: Apple Developer Program License Agreement
